args.text: Pacing and fun: the turn report and event cards keep things moving, which is nice. But tapping Defend on the '25,770 men marching on Jerusalem' line only opened the city's Battle Housing page. It didn't tell me what to do next to defend. My army had already stopped next to an enemy, and I never got a battle or a clear 'attack' button. As a new player I feel the threat building but don't know how to act on it, so the tension turns into confusion instead of fun.

args.summary: I played the session through to the first auto battle at Sippar (8,590 of my men against 20,000). Good: the turn reports, event and era goal cards, the advisor pick for builds, autosave and the clear auto battle bar keep things moving. Problems: 1) I couldn't find my own army without zooming out, and tapping it often hit an enemy unit instead. 2) Tapping Defend on the threat line only opened a city info page and didn't explain how to defend. 3) The march preview called 10k against 1.6k at Sippar 'hopeless' without saying why. 4) When marching, tapping can open other panels by mistake (once a Cities list opened). As a new player, the war felt tense but I was often lost about what to do next.

thought: The battle is running on Auto, and this is my last step, so I'm wrapping up.
